title: AIPAC Exposed: Mehdi Speaks to Authors of New Book on the Israel Lobby
author: Mehdi Hasan
content:
Why can't the U.S. stand up to [Israel](https://zeteo.com/p/gaza-genocide-
bret-stephens?r=3uiw9m)? Who is the bigger benefactor of this partnership? And
is the Israel lobby's [influence](https://zeteo.com/p/will-this-be-aipacs-
biggest-defeat?r=3uiw9m) in the U.S. waning? With AIPAC-backed candidates in
this year's [midterm elections](https://zeteo.com/p/here-come-the-super-
islamophobic?r=3uiw9m) struggling to win despite their massive war chests,
**Mehdi** talks to the authors of the new book, _' Israel's Lobby: America in
the Grip of a Foreign Power,'_ who explain the shift in the notorious lobby's
influence.

[Subscribe now](https://zeteo.com/subscribe)

**" There's one issue they [AIPAC] won't talk about,"** says **Eli Clifton** ,
co-author and cofounder of the Quincy Institute for Responsible Statecraft,
**" they don't talk about Israel, and I think that that's the admission from
AIPAC…that their actual issue is toxic." **Clifton notes that pro-Israel super
PACs could end up raising and spending a quarter of a billion dollars this
election cycle alone.

But it's not all about money, as **Ian Lustick,** co-author and former State
Department expert on Israel-[Palestine](https://zeteo.com/p/this-week-in-
palestine-unicef-reports?r=3uiw9m) affairs, tells Mehdi.** "I spoke with
Blinken and Sullivan and Biden, trying to tell them what the actual
[situation](https://zeteo.com/p/israel-has-imprisoned-a-16-year-old?r=3uiw9m)
in Israel was like. But they're socialized psychologically not to even be able
to include in their agenda of possibilities what the realities are there."**

Watch this important conversation to understand how the U.S. paved the way for
Israel to become the** "extreme right-wing rogue state"** it is today, as
Lustick puts it, how people can push back against the lobby's influence in the
U.S., and a lot more.
